home.heroBody: One photo → name, care guide, health check and whether it's safe to eat.
home.limitReached: You've reached today's scan limit — back tomorrow 🌙
home.freeUsed: Free scans used — watch a short video for more

capture.cameraPermBody: Enable camera access in Settings to take a photo.
capture.photosPermBody: Enable photo library access in Settings.
capture.title: Add up to {{max}} photos
capture.tip: A close-up of a leaf plus one wider shot of the whole plant gives the best results.
capture.limitNote: You've used all {{cap}} scans for today. Your plants and care guides are still here — new scans unlock tomorrow.
capture.adNote: Today's free scans are used. A short video unlocks each extra scan — it plays while we analyze, so you don't wait longer. ({{left}} left today)

analyzing.tip1: 🌱 Most houseplant deaths are from overwatering, not underwatering.
analyzing.tip2: 🔍 Checking the undersides of leaves is the fastest way to catch pests early.
analyzing.tip3: ☀️ 'Bright indirect light' means bright, but no direct sun rays hitting the leaves.
analyzing.tip4: 🪴 A pot with no drainage hole is one of the most common causes of root rot.
analyzing.tip5: 🌡️ Most tropical houseplants dislike cold drafts near windows and doors.
analyzing.lockedBody: Finish the short video to unlock it. Rewards only count when the video plays to the end.
analyzing.limitBody: You've reached today's scan limit. Your plants, reminders and care guides all still work — new scans unlock tomorrow.
analyzing.errorBody: Something went wrong. Check your internet connection and try again.

history.deleteBody: This can't be undone. Plants in My Plants keep their photo and reminders.
history.empty: No scans yet. Go scan a plant!
history.longPressHint: Long-press a scan to delete it.

plants.emptyBody: Scan a plant, then tap “Add to My Plants” — Leafkin will remind you when it needs water.

plant.remindersOff: Reminders are off — turn them on in Settings.
plant.removeBody: Its watering reminders will stop. The original scan stays in History.
plant.renameHint: Tap the name to rename it (e.g. “Kitchen monstera”).
plant.intervalTip: Soil still wet on reminder day? Add a day or two. Drying out fast in summer? Take a day off.

result.addedOffBody: Allow notifications for Leafkin in your phone settings to get watering reminders.
result.lastWateredTitle: When did you last water it?
result.lastWateredBody: So your first reminder lands on the right day.
result.notPlantFallback: Try a clearer, well-lit photo of the plant.
result.lowConfidence: ⚠️ Not fully confident about this ID ({{pct}}%). Consider a clearer photo for a firmer answer.
result.wateringEvery_one: Watering every day · tap to manage
result.wateringEvery_other: Watering every {{count}} days · tap to manage
result.addToPlants_one: 🪴 Add to My Plants · water every day
result.addToPlants_other: 🪴 Add to My Plants · water every {{count}} days

settings.notifOff: Notifications are off, so Leafkin can't remind you to water.
settings.scansAdFree: Up to {{cap}} scans a day, no videos.
settings.scansFree: {{free}} free scans every day. After that, a short optional video unlocks each extra scan (up to {{cap}} a day).
settings.adFreeThanks: Ad-free — thank you for supporting Leafkin! 💚
settings.adsSupported: Leafkin is free, supported by a few small ads.
settings.disclaimer: Plant identification, care, health and edibility guidance is generated by AI and may occasionally be wrong. Never eat a wild plant based solely on this app — always confirm with a local expert first.

removeAds.title: Leafkin, ad-free
removeAds.subtitle: Everything stays free. This just makes it quieter.

removeAds.benefit2: ▶️ No videos — up to {{cap}} scans a day, straight to results
removeAds.benefit3: 💚 One payment, yours forever — not a subscription
removeAds.benefit4: 🌱 Helps keep Leafkin free for everyone else
